summary: BACKEND-DEV (WF-02 Step 3 UNBLOCK-EVERYTHING) fixed ISS-0715 / GitHub #812 (BLOCKER): fresh per-tenant schema provisioning now succeeds. Verified root cause with a faithful per-tenant migration-chain reproducer (scratch/repro_iss0715.py) and live-bootstrap evidence (a partially-provisioned fresh schema's ledger stops at 093): the IMMEDIATE blocker is migration 094_entity_subsystem.sql, whose all_schemas per-tenant re-run tries CREATE INDEX ... ON public.entity_definitions (tenant_id, ...) / entity_record_latest (tenant_id, ...) after GBL-123 removed tenant_id from those public GLOBAL_REGISTRY tables (sqlstate 42703, ComputeIndexAttrs). Migration 020 applies cleanly on a fresh schema (it is in the fresh schema's ledger); its documented 'cannot change return type' failure is a LATENT re-provision defect (re-running 020 after 1139 installed the TEXT copy in the current schema). Fixes applied: (1) migration 020 made schema-aware — DO $$ EXECUTE format('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS %I.bpm_audit_resource_info(text,jsonb,jsonb)', current_schema()) $$ before the unqualified CREATE OR REPLACE, mirroring GBL-120/1139 DROP-then-CREATE; (2) migration 094's four tenant_id-dependent public indexes guarded behind an information_schema column-exists check so they are created in the public pass and become no-ops per-tenant. Verification: zig build exit 0; zig build test exit 0; zig build migrate exit 0 (No new migrations to apply, applies cleanly); zig build test-integration-spt 16/16 PASS (incl. the 6 previously blocked: TC-SPT-02-02, TC-SPT-03-02/03/04/05, TC-SPT-04-04); test-integration-spt01-iss68 3/3 PASS (SPT-01 provisioning); lint_migration_schema 0 violations; lint_handoffs exit 0. No regression: public.bpm_audit_resource_info still TEXT (resource_id text), tenant_default unchanged (resource_id uuid), public entity tables still lack tenant_id. ISS-0715.json root cause corrected to the verified reality.

issues_found.description: ISS-0715 / GitHub #812 root-cause attribution was WRONG for the fresh-provisioning path: TEST-DESIGNER attributed the fresh-schema failure to migration 020 'cannot change return type'. BACKEND-DEV verified the IMMEDIATE blocker is migration 094_entity_subsystem.sql (per-tenant re-run of public-qualified tenant_id indexes on GLOBAL_REGISTRY tables after GBL-123 removed public tenant_id; 42703). 020 is a real but LATENT re-provision defect (re-running 020 in a schema that already carries the TEXT copy from 1139). Both were fixed in this run; ISS-0715.json corrected.

094's all_schemas/public-qualified-work defect class is a recurrence of the pattern documented in ISS-0112/ISS-0630 (entity_definitions/entity_record_latest GLOBAL_REGISTRY vs per-tenant re-run). This fix guards the indexes; the underlying lint-level prevention (flag schema-qualified CREATE INDEX inside an all_schemas migration whose table's columns changed in a later public-only migration) is a candidate follow-up, not implemented here.

Two unit-test binaries (test-iss0173-orphan, test-differential) intermittently print 'failed command:' lines under zig build test while passing standalone and with the overall step exiting 0 — believed to be a stale cached-run artifact; not caused by this change (migrations-only diff).
